groups.defect: AccessTokenContext checks grantType twice and never validates rawTokenId against null.
groups.rationale: All four identify the same constructor copy-paste error and the same replacement of the second null check.

groups.defect: The access-token ID matcher extracts the wrong grant substring, inverts the equality check, and lacks prefix-length validation before substring extraction.
groups.rationale: Every member reports the same offset and polarity errors in isAccessTokenId; several also report the missing length guard. The merged comment must preserve these overlapping defects.

groups.defect: OAuth2GrantType.Context loses its copy constructor, leaves cached grantType stale after setFormParams(), and dereferences nullable formParams during construction.
groups.rationale: s_f886b821 overlaps s_ce1639a8 on stale grantType and s_611afbf2 on the constructor null dereference, joining all three transitively. The removed copy constructor is an additional defect that must survive consolidation.
